Run Manually.label: Run now
Run Manually.desc: Lets the professor start a grading run on demand.

Every 6 Hours.label: Every 6 hours
Every 6 Hours.desc: Runs automatically every 6 hours, so new submissions get graded without anyone pressing a button.

Config.label: Settings
Config.desc: One place to set the course, results sheet, Gemini model, grading rubric, allowed AI-use percentage and how many submissions to grade per run.

Create Guides Tab.label: Create Guides tab
Create Guides Tab.desc: Makes sure the spreadsheet has a Guides tab (skips quietly if it already exists).

Write Guides Header.label: Write sheet headers
Write Guides Header.desc: Writes the column headers for the Guides and Results tabs.

Read Graded Rows.label: Read graded rows
Read Graded Rows.desc: Loads everything already graded, so no submission is ever graded twice.

Read Guides.label: Read saved guides
Read Guides.desc: Loads the grading guides already built for each assignment.

Get Assignments.label: Get assignments
Get Assignments.desc: Fetches every assignment in the course, page by page.

Get Students.label: Get students
Get Students.desc: Fetches the class list so each submission is matched to the right student.

Build Submission List.label: Build submission list
Build Submission List.desc: Combines submissions with student and assignment details, and skips anything already in the Results sheet.

Find Missing Guides.label: Find missing guides
Find Missing Guides.desc: Checks which assignments don't have a grading guide yet. A guide is built once per assignment and reused for every student — that keeps AI costs low.

Need Guide?.label: New guide needed?
Need Guide?.desc: Builds a guide only for assignments that don't have one yet.

Find Answer Key.label: Find answer key
Find Answer Key.desc: Looks in the professor's private Drive folder for an answer key that matches the assignment name.

Expand Guide Files.label: Collect guide files
Expand Guide Files.desc: Gathers the assignment's question files plus the best-matching answer key.

Get Guide File Info.label: Check file types
Get Guide File Info.desc: Reads each file's type so only Google Docs and PDFs are used.

Download Guide File.label: Download files
Download Guide File.desc: Downloads the question paper and answer key (Google Docs are exported as PDF).

Build Guide Requests.label: Prepare guide prompt
Build Guide Requests.desc: Builds one Gemini request per assignment, with the questions, answer key and the professor's rubric attached.

Generate Guide.label: Generate grading guide
Generate Guide.desc: Gemini writes a compact marking guide: marks per question, key points for full marks and common mistakes. Retries automatically if it fails.

Format Guide Row.label: Format guide
Format Guide Row.desc: Turns Gemini's answer into a row for the Guides tab; failures are marked so they're retried on the next run.

Save Guides.label: Save guide
Save Guides.desc: Saves the guide to the Guides tab. The professor can edit it, and the edited version is used from the next run.

Continue to Grading.label: Start grading
Continue to Grading.desc: Waits until any new guides are ready, then starts grading once.

Attach Guides.label: Attach guide
Attach Guides.desc: Adds the right grading guide to every pending submission.

Has File?.label: File attached?
Has File?.desc: Checks that the student actually attached a file.

Get File Metadata.label: Check file type
Get File Metadata.desc: Reads the attached file's type and size.

Route by File Type.label: Route by file type
Route by File Type.desc: Sends each file down the right path: Google Docs, PDFs and Word files are all turned into PDFs for the AI; anything else goes to manual review.

Export Google Doc as PDF.label: Export Doc as PDF
Export Google Doc as PDF.desc: Converts a Google Doc submission to PDF.

Convert Word to Google Doc.label: Convert Word file
Convert Word to Google Doc.desc: Makes a temporary Google Doc copy of a Word or text file so it can be exported as PDF.

Export Converted as PDF.label: Export as PDF
Export Converted as PDF.desc: Exports the converted copy as a PDF.

Delete Temp Copy.label: Delete temp copy
Delete Temp Copy.desc: Deletes the temporary copy so the professor's Drive stays tidy.

Manual Review Row.label: Flag for manual review
Manual Review Row.desc: Missing or unsupported files still get a row marked “Needs manual review”, so no student is ever missed.

Build Gemini Request.label: Prepare grading request
Build Gemini Request.desc: Sends Gemini only the short grading guide plus the student's PDF, and asks for structured results: score, remarks, strengths, improvements, flags and an AI-use estimate — with strict rules to avoid wrongly accusing students.

Check with Gemini.label: Grade with Gemini
Check with Gemini.desc: Gemini marks the submission. Requests are spaced out to respect rate limits and retried automatically on failure.

Format Graded Row.label: Score & grade
Format Graded Row.desc: Works out the percentage and letter grade, applies the AI-use policy (flag, or deduct marks above the allowed %), and builds the results row.

Save to Results Sheet.label: Save to Results
Save to Results Sheet.desc: Adds every graded submission to the Results tab.

Group by Assignment.label: Group by assignment
Group by Assignment.desc: Groups the new results by assignment.

Create Assignment Tab.label: Create assignment tab
Create Assignment Tab.desc: Creates a separate tab for each assignment if it doesn't exist yet.

Prepare Tab Rows.label: Prepare tab rows
Prepare Tab Rows.desc: Adds a header row when a tab is brand new.

Append to Assignment Tab.label: Append to assignment tab
Append to Assignment Tab.desc: Copies the results into that assignment's own tab, so the professor can review one assignment at a time.

Find Course & Assignment IDs.label: Find course IDs
Find Course & Assignment IDs.desc: A one-time helper the professor runs to find the course and assignment IDs to paste into Settings.

Split Courses.label: Split courses
Split Courses.desc: Turns the course list into one item per course.

List Course Assignments.label: List assignments
List Course Assignments.desc: Lists the assignments in each course.

Show IDs.label: Show IDs
Show IDs.desc: Shows every course and assignment with the ID to copy into Settings.
